headline: RBI Schedules ₹50,000 Crore Overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced it will conduct an overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction of 50,000 crore rupees on November 19, 2026, to manage evolving systemic liquidity conditions.
why: The RBI uses variable rate reverse repo operations to absorb surplus cash from the banking system and guide short-term interbank money-market rates.

impacts.name: Indian Overnight Interbank Rate
impacts.why: A 50,000 crore rupee VRRR operation directly absorbs banking-system liquidity to steer overnight money-market borrowing costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
